issues.description: Method Stock.getStockIngredients: the template declares getStockIngredients() to return java.util.List<StockIngredient> (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) while the solution declares getStockIngredients() to return StockIngredient[] (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java). The problem statement asks students to "add getters for all the private fields" but does not specify the exact getter return type for the stockIngredients field. This mismatch is confusing because setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) in both template and solution uses an array, Main and other code exercise usage expect an array in the solution, and students may be unsure whether to implement or use a List or array for getStockIngredients, potentially leading to compilation or interoperability issues between student code and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of Stock.getStockIngredients consistent across template, solution, and instructions. Prefer returning StockIngredient[] to match setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) and the solution implementation: update the template method signature to public StockIngredient[] getStockIngredients() and return this.stockIngredients. Also clarify in the problem statement that the getter for stockIngredients should return StockIngredient[] so students implement the expected signature.
